exposure: Invasive placenta (placenta increta and percreta) vs. non-invasive placenta
internal iliac artery preset balloon occlusion before caesarean section
Prophylactic balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery
cohort: 104 patients with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) complicated with placenta previa who delivered by caesarean section between January 2016 and January 2019
finding: Prophylactic balloon occlusion of the internal iliac artery is effective for reducing blood loss in patients with placenta previa without invasive placenta, but not in those with invasive placenta.
